messages.subject: Your witness statement - draft for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Draft of your first witness statement is ready for your review (I'll send via the secure portal). It covers the Agreement and acceptance regime, Caldervale's data and host-environment failures, the promotional surge, the invoices and the termination. Please check the dates and the technical detail, especially the 22% SKU figure and the 31ms latency, and let me have any comments by Friday so we can finalise ahead of exchange.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
